Body.Content:
With this feature, admins can scope their network data security data loss prevention policies, integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access, to apply to all websites (.) or all websites except specific cloud apps, allowing them to apply protection to cloud apps and websites that are not in the Defender Cloud App Catalog.

GA date: December CY2026

Preview date: November CY2026
